parties.respondent: State Represented By Inspector Of Police

summary: Conviction under IPC s.304 Part I and s.201; grave and sudden provocation analysis; Exception 1 to s.300 IPC examined; test of reasonable man losing self-control; interval between provocation and act critical; use of deadly instrument considered; benefit of exception dependent on objective assessment; appeal implications pending State's non-appeal status; imprisonment period noted.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code s.304 Part I
final_judgment: Appeal disposed of with observations; conviction under s.304 Part I and s.201 upheld; sentence of 5 years RI and fine maintained; no enhancement due to non-appeal by State.
